title: 第二十五章 这真是运气第二十六章 没怪过她
content_zh:
“不远吗？”
才哥挠了挠头，倒也不是很确定，略疑惑了一下就撂过这个小问题，又开始算这一趟能赚多少钱。
刚开始他听说可能找到一个乌鲻鱼群，己经高兴坏了。
而乌鲻鱼如果不能加工乌鱼子卖钱，只卖鱼肉就是二十多块一斤，可是银鲳鱼却是六十多块一斤，一万多斤银鲳鱼至少得有六十多万呐！
这次真是赚大发了！
才哥眉飞色舞，心里琢磨着，一定要把殷东牢牢的拴在自家船上，宁可多分一点钱给殷东。
他现在就得意不己，亏得他没在意村里的谣言，相信殷东父子俩带煞的鬼话，坚定的把殷东请到了他的船上。
回到村里的老码头，己经是晚上八点多了，才哥让大家都赶紧回去冲个澡了吃饭，那些鱼就先留在渔船的冷库里，等明天一早，他再联系收购商。
码头上有晚归的渔船，基本渔获都不多，听说才哥的船捕捞到一万多斤银鲳鱼，顿时都轰动起来，涌到才哥的船上来看。
“多亏了东子，要不是东子坚持，就错过了这个银鲳鱼群啊。”
良叔大声感慨，顿时把所有人的目光都引到殷东身上。
“运气，这真是运气。”
殷东并不想出这种风头，随意敷衍了两声，就从人群中挤出去，匆匆赶回家。
此时，小宝躺在摇篮里，兰子正在慢慢的摇着摇篮，己经快要把小宝摇睡着了。
“嫂子，辛苦你了。”
殷东冲才嫂打了个招呼，又对兰子说：“兰子真乖，都把弟弟哄睡着了。”
兰子萌甜的说：“弟弟也乖。”
才嫂也笑道：“小宝是真的很乖，都没哭过，比兰子好带多了。”
这时，小宝睁开眼，看到殷东，顿时小嘴儿一撇，委屈的哭了起来。
殷东不由笑道：“你小子还成了精了，看到你爹就哭。

不许哭，再哭我揍你了哦！”
“小宝是在给你撒娇呢，一天没见你了。”
才嫂笑着说完，又有些不安的问：“你才哥今天心情好不好？”
殷东觉得这话问得挺奇怪的：“才哥心情每天都很好吧。”
才嫂把手放在女儿头顶，轻轻揉了揉，叹道：“没有渔获，他就会在家里喝闷酒，还打兰子。
要是你才哥心情不好，我想让兰子就在你家歇一晚。”
殷东愕了一下，忙说：“哦，嫂子，才哥今天心情很好，今天捞到一万多斤银鲳鱼。”
等才嫂带着兰子欢欢喜喜的走了以后，殷东正要关门，王海生又跑过来了，隔老远就大呼小叫：“东子，你小子忒不是东西了啊，有鱼群的消息都不告诉我！”
殷东乐了：“你消息挺灵通的啊！”
“才哥发微信群了，我才看到，我们这一带很少有这么大的银鲳鱼群了，怎么就让你们给撞上了？”
王海生笑着，冲殷东挤了挤眼，进了院子，又低笑道：“这一下村里好多人都悔得肠子青，我爸妈也都在家里后悔呢。”
殷东懒得接这话茬，让他去看着小宝，自己去冲了个热水澡，然后把才嫂做好的饭菜端出来，跟王海生一块吃。
王海生挟了一筷子红烧鱼，尝了一口，竟然还嫌弃上了：“没你烧得好吃，东子，你再去烧两个菜吧。”
content_en:
"Not far?"
Brother Cai scratched his head, not entirely sure. After a moment of confusion, he put aside this small problem and started calculating how much money he could make from this trip.
At first he was overjoyed when he heard that he might find a school of black mullet.
If the black mullet cannot be processed into mullet roe and sold for money, the fish meat alone will cost more than 20 yuan per catty, but the silver pomfret will cost more than 60 yuan per catty. The silver pomfret with more than 10,000 catties must cost at least more than 600,000 yuan!
This time I really made a lot of money!
Brother Cai was very happy, thinking in his mind that he must tie Yin Dong tightly to his own boat, and would rather give Yin Dong more money.
He was very proud now. Fortunately, he didn't pay attention to the rumors in the village. He believed the evil lies of Yin Dong and his son, and firmly invited Yin Dong to his ship.
When we returned to the old dock in the village, it was already past eight o'clock in the evening. Brother Cai asked everyone to go back and take a shower and eat. The fish were left in the cold storage of the fishing boat. He would contact the purchaser early tomorrow morning.
There were fishing boats returning late at the pier, and they basically didn't catch much. When they heard that Cai Ge's boat had caught more than 10,000 kilograms of silver pomfret, everyone immediately became excited and flocked to Cai Ge's boat to see it.
"Thanks to Dongzi. If Dongzi hadn't insisted, we would have missed this school of silver pomfret."
Uncle Liang sighed loudly, immediately drawing everyone's attention to Yin Dong.
"Luck, that's real luck."
Yin Dong didn't want to be in such limelight, so he just said a few casual words, squeezed out of the crowd, and hurried home.
At this time, Xiaobao was lying in the cradle, and Lanzi was slowly rocking the cradle, almost rocking Xiaobao to sleep.
"Sister-in-law, thank you for your hard work."
Yin Dongchong said hello to Cai's wife, and then said to Lanzi: "Lanzi is so good, he even coaxed his brother to sleep."
Lanzi said sweetly: "My brother is also good."
Sister-in-law Cai also smiled and said: "Xiaobao is really well-behaved and has never cried. He is much easier to take care of than Lanzi."
At this time, Xiaobao opened his eyes and saw Yin Dong. He suddenly curled up his mouth and started crying in grievance.
Yin Dong couldn't help but laugh and said: "Your boy has become a sperm, and he cries when he sees your father.
Don't cry, I'll beat you if you cry again! "
"Xiaobao is just acting coquettishly for you. I haven't seen you for a day."
After finishing speaking, Sister Cai smiled and asked a little uneasily: "Brother Cai, are you in a good mood today?"
Yin Dong thought this question was quite strange: "Brother Cai is in a good mood every day."
Mrs. Cai put her hand on her daughter's head, rubbed it gently, and sighed: "If there is no catch, he will drink at home and shoot orchids.
If your brother Cai is in a bad mood, I want Lanzi to rest at your house for a night. "
Yin Dong was stunned for a moment and said quickly: "Oh, sister-in-law, Brother Cai is in a good mood today. He caught more than 10,000 kilograms of silver pomfret today."
After Cai's sister-in-law left happily with Lanzi, Yin Dong was about to close the door when Wang Haisheng ran over again, shouting from a distance: "Dongzi, you are so useless, you don't even tell me about the fish school!"
Yin Dong was delighted: "You are quite well-informed!"
"Brother Cai sent a message to the WeChat group, and I just saw that there are rarely such a big school of silver pomfret in our area. Why did you guys run into them?"
Wang Haisheng smiled, winked at Yin Dong, entered the yard, and chuckled again: "Now many people in the village are regretful. My parents are also regretting it at home."
Yin Dong was too lazy to answer the question and asked him to look at Xiaobao while he took a hot shower. Then he took out the food prepared by Sister Cai and ate it with Wang Haisheng.
Wang Haisheng took a piece of braised fish with chopsticks, took a bite, and actually disliked it: "It's not as delicious as yours, Dongzi, go ahead and cook two more dishes."
